description: Run one read-only SQL statement against public and get up to 500 rows back. Read-only: it never commits.

limit.description: Return at most this many rows (default and maximum 500).

params.description: Values for $1, $2 …: strings, integers, booleans or null; at most 100.

sql.description: One read-only SQL statement (SELECT). Use $1, $2 … for values.

name: postgres_query
title: Query
